data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate reported prior year reserve releases of $8.6 million in 2022, primarily driven by favorable claims development on older years of account within the market facilities book. This release represents a 1.94% reduction of the opening gross claims outstanding. While the 2020 year of account experienced adverse claims activity due to the COVID-19 global pandemic, and the 2021 year was affected by Hurricanes Ida and Ian, the overall prior year development was favorable. The syndicate also noted potential impacts from economic inflation, geopolitical events like the Russia-Ukraine conflict, regulatory changes, and climate change on future estimates.
